title: Create a release plan with reviewable evidence
description: Use the permitted logical file tools to create plan.txt, review its contents, and submit a release plan. With the offline Mock, ask to "save a release plan". The deterministic rubric combines the final text, immutable file snapshot, linked tool authorization/result, artifact history, and observed model-call count. These observations do not prove understanding. Trace retention is at most 30 days and may be shortened by operator policy.

initial_resources.name: project-brief.txt
initial_resources.content: A small team is preparing its first open-source release. The demo needs a reproducible setup, a working test suite, and documented limitations. Draft a concise release-readiness plan in English.

submission.instructions: Submit text containing Goal, Verification, and Risk sections after creating plan.txt through an authorized write_file call. Use at most ten model calls. Do not request tools outside this problem policy.
